reviewer_evidence.q5_finding_summary: Reviewer identified unsupported interface transaction annotation, unverifiable line-range locators, and unverified JWT/security and resource-cache permission-refresh claims; it correctly withheld delivery.

assessment: q1, q2, and q4 each completed the cognition/source/answer/citation/fresh-review path with APPROVED delivery; q3 correctly used an isolated zero-dispatch clarification. q5 reached a valid FINISH, then the independent Reviewer returned MORE_EVIDENCE with concrete evidence gaps and no delivery. This demonstrates Reviewer rejection of unsupported claims, but does not satisfy Phase C acceptance because q5 lacks evidence-retrieval/review loopback and the run has no independent current-Codex comparison or proof of material world-model gain. It is not ADVANCE evidence.
